fnol_text: My name is Dmitri Raman and I live at 340 Linden Court, Ashland, OR 97577. You can reach me on (555) 915-9778 or dmitri.raman@example.com. A delivery driver slipped on our icy front steps on 6 December 2025 and was taken to hospital. They have said they will make a claim against us. Policy HH-2023-00109. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home. Can you confirm I'm covered for this?

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Raman on (555) 915-9778 to acknowledge the claim. Dmitri confirmed the loss date as 6 December 2025.
Site visit to 340 Linden Court. Neighbour Sofia Gallagher was present and confirmed the timeline.
Injured party Aisha Fitzgerald sustained minor burns to the hand and was treated at County General. Do not admit liability; refer.
